characters.description: A prominent Wanderers leader whose healing, ritual work, and service during the recent war make him central to the guild's survival and growth.
characters.name: Joe

characters.description: The ruler Joe restored to life during the war. He publicly rewards Joe for saving him and advances Joe along the path toward nobility.
characters.name: King Henry

characters.description: The monarch who questions how Joe managed to restore King Henry to life.
characters.name: Queen

characters.description: An operator within the Grand Zoo who unexpectedly improves Joe's standing with the organization. His reason for doing so is not yet clear.
characters.name: Robert

characters.description: The Wanderers commander overseeing postwar reconstruction. He orders inquiries into abuses of authority while coordinating fortification and cooperation across the damaged settlement.
characters.name: Aten

characters.description: Joe's divine patron, placed under review after the extraordinary effort used to resurrect King Henry. The patron's immense energy debt becomes Joe's responsibility.
characters.name: Joe's deity

characters.description: The Wanderers vice-guild leader and a retired lieutenant colonel. He approaches Joe with the immediate practical problem of housing people who can no longer leave the world.
characters.name: Mike

characters.description: A Wanderers combatant returning from the Wolfman front with paired living weapons in place of ordinary hands. He travels with Jess and reunites with Joe's group.
characters.name: Jaxon

characters.description: Jaxon's traveling companion, seeking work in strategy and logistics. She joins the party's next expedition as a prospective collaborator who has not yet been fully tested.
characters.name: Jess

characters.description: A Wanderers combatant who returns from the Wolfman front after helping prevent violence against Wolfman civilians.
characters.name: Alexis

characters.description: A musician and combatant with the Wanderers who returns alongside Alexis and Poppy after their work on the Wolfman front.
characters.name: Bard

characters.description: A Wanderers duelist who returns from the Wolfman front with Bard and Alexis, rejoining Joe's active party.
characters.name: Poppy

characters.description: A masked agent of an organization that controls trade in rare creatures. He attempts to execute Joe over an earlier sale, then demands the capture of a coffee elemental instead.
characters.name: Masked jester assassin

characters.description: The leader of a newly formed farming guild whose poisoned caravan Joe rescues. She agrees to try Joe's faith and introduce it to her guild.
characters.name: Farming-guild captain

characters.description: The elderly shaman who leads a concealed Wolfman refuge and is an established ally of Jaxon. She offers access to the refuge's growth houses if Joe's party clears a nearby temple.
characters.name: Wolfman elder

characters.description: The leader of the human cult occupying a forest cathedral. The building's compulsive influence and magical amplification strengthen his command over its followers.
characters.name: Cult hierophant

characters.description: An enchanter in training who works with Joe while he develops a core-powered mana battery.
characters.name: Tara

characters.description: A former warrior-mage with programming knowledge who helps Joe reason through the structure of a difficult ritual.
characters.name: Former warrior-mage

characters.description: One of Joe's first Ritualist coven members, introduced as a would-be villain whose abilities have the unintended effect of helping people.
characters.name: Kirby

characters.description: One of the initial members of Joe's Ritualist coven, joining the group's work on rechargeable mana storage.
characters.name: Hannah

characters.description: A ranger in Joe's first Ritualist coven. His damaged necromancer class allows him to summon a single skeleton.
characters.name: Robert

characters.description: A thief who joins Joe's first Ritualist coven while seeking a future change to an alchemist class.
characters.name: Thief coven member

characters.description: A fragment of the Burning Mind released from the captured cathedral's altar. Its attacks can cause permanent, data-destroying death.
characters.name: Game Over

characters.description: The Wanderers head herbalist and a druid entrusted with operating the newly completed greenhouse and establishing its first crops.
characters.name: Finn

characters.description: A royal healer whom Joe previously saved. He warns that the Wanderers' copied wall exposes the guild to a treason charge and imminent seizure by the Royal Guard.
characters.name: Prince

characters.description: The queen who orders Joe to investigate the Grand Zoo in exchange for resolving the accusation surrounding the Wanderers' copied defensive wall.
characters.name: Queen Marie

characters.description: An alchemical supplier who provides Joe with rare, hazardous ritual reagents while facing pressure on his own supply network.
characters.name: Jake
